A live PM inbox re-read finds ZERO Meta or Facebook mail of any kind — no ad-review decision, no billing receipt, no lead — and today's fresh v15.13 cofounder sweep says the same and formalizes it as new Waiting W15: launch on the record, or declare a dated hold. spotlight.title: The video kit — 8 days open, and it is why there is nothing to launch WITH
spotlight.detail: Eight days as your entire allocation and it still has not happened, which makes it the hardest of the four gates — instrumentation can be switched on in an afternoon; footage cannot be conjured. One session is the only source for four things: the founder-ad creative, a creative with your face, the landing-page refresh, and the ElevenLabs voice clone (audio is extracted from the same takes). Shirt + tie, iPhone at 4K/60fps per the kit, ~20-24 min of material, hand it to Chitraksh. And in the same five minutes, send the compliance furniture: your NPN, your CA producer-licence #, and the not-guaranteed / rates-vary wording. The old ad account was banned for the absence of exactly those three — no licence identifiers, a guaranteed-sounding price teaser, an all-text PNG. No footage and no numbers means no compliant creative, which means no launch, three days running.

spotlight.title: Analytics ON + Meta MCP connected — both still unconfirmed a week later
spotlight.detail: These two have been the named pre-spend gate since Aug 5 and neither has been confirmed closed in seven days. Without Vercel Analytics, Frankie's question — 'is anyone even visiting the site?' — stays unanswerable and the $600 buys traffic nobody can measure or learn from; his own caution is on the record, the free tier answers it without overspending on tooling. Without the Meta MCP attached, creatives cannot be pushed or monitored programmatically and the whole test has to be driven by hand. Neither is a build; both are connections. Close them today and the next launch is real instead of blind. The discipline binds the moment it goes live: never raise budget more than 20-25% inside 3-4 days or Andromeda re-enters learning, and plan the ~15-day creative refresh into batch 2 now.

spotlight.title: T+3 — fire the $600 today, or declare the W15 hold date
spotlight.detail: Monday's brief asked for this call and the answer was neither; two more days passed the same way. That ends today, in one direction or the other. If Analytics is live, the MCP is connected, and every creative plus the landing page carries the compliance trio, fire the $600 — final expense only, 4 states, and do not pull the plug early ('nobody stays long enough to see the system work'). If it cannot all close, say out loud that the launch is HELD to a named date and record it — this is now Waiting W15: launch on the record, or a dated hold — a recorded pause is a decision that can be managed; a launch date that simply slides is the exact drift 3-per-15 was built to kill. Settle W14 in the same breath: the VC-connect phantom failed again Aug 10 20:20Z, minutes after the last brief claimed a quieter picture, and it is still an automated connection sequence aimed at the lane Meeting 38 defined as relationship-first and 12-24 months pre-raise. Decide it OFF before anyone re-pastes a cookie, or the repair simply resumes the thing you said you did not want.
